title: Function usage examples
responsibility: Shows short example titles and literal calls with expected output comments.

inputs.name: UsageExamples.examples
inputs.description: Committed invocation code and expected JSON outputs or errors.

inputs.name: UsageExamples.setup
inputs.description: Optional legacy setup included inside each code block without executing it.

inputs.name: UsageExamples.setupTitle
inputs.description: Optional heading for setup rendered once before the example snippets.

outputs.name: UsageExamples
outputs.description: Short titles and code blocks, or an explicit message when no usage examples are recorded.

outputs.name: compact
outputs.description: Compact JSON text with whitespace that permits line wrapping.

outputs.name: usageExamples
outputs.description: Literal code snippets followed by expected output or throws comments.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: An example containing BigInt cannot be serialized.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: The recursive formatter cannot render a circular example.

errors.name: Value access or conversion error
errors.description: A supplied getter, proxy or value conversion callback can throw while formatting an example.
